spec_match.rationale: Separates the two spec windows precisely: pre-response abort rejecting the fetch promise (long-standing) versus post-response abort rejecting the body read (the 153 fix), each driven with a real marked reason.

interactive.rationale: Both phases run real fetches against the streaming route with millisecond event timelines assembled from live behavior.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises a per-phase comparison tool; the page delivers per-phase timelines, a verdict table, and a combined summary.

edge_cases.rationale: Abort-lost-the-race and body-beat-the-abort are labelled inconclusive with a run-again hint; route unreachable is handled; a non-abort rejection (e.g. a mid-read network TypeError) is now classified inconclusive rather than counted as the pre-153 substitution (Codex review round 2).

references.rationale: Links the ChromeStatus entry, the earlier AbortSignal.reason fetch integration entry (the phase-1 half), and MDN.

conformance.rationale: The suite's pre-response and post-response assertions mirror the two phases exactly; on this build phase 1 passes and phase 2 honestly fails.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via CDP: both phases run; phase 1 kept the TimeoutError marker, phase 2 substituted AbortError; summary correctly identified the pre-153 gap; console/network clean; both classes screenshotted.

telemetry_health.rationale: Per-phase asserts record kept/inconclusive with details.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout; timeline hit rows invert black/ivory with both properties set; kept/lost verdict colors are AA-adjusted (emerald darkened via color-mix) and duplicated in text.

accessibility.rationale: Buttons are native with 44px targets, timelines are labelled lists, the verdict table has scoped headers, and the summary is role=status aria-live=polite.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP matrix: overflow 0 at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800, monospace timeline rows wrap with overflow-wrap anywhere. Harness responsive-check confirms ok on both classes after the same-origin failure-scoping fix (Codex review round 1).

openQuestions.title: Capture the both-phases-forwarded summary on Chrome 153+
openQuestions.detail: On this pre-153 build only the split verdict (phase 1 kept / phase 2 substituted) could be observed. Re-run on Chrome 153+ to confirm the complete-contract summary branch renders.

guidanceConsulted.query: async action button pending state error retry accessible status live region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Disable async-run buttons while in flight and surface results through status semantics.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each phase button disables during its run (finally re-enables); the cross-phase summary is a single aria-live status; timelines are appended, never replaced mid-read.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: npx modern-web-guidance@latest search run 2026-08-09; no abort-reason-specific guide exists, general async-action guidance applied.

summary: Verified with headless Chromium 141 via CDP: phase 1 forwarded (TimeoutError marker kept), phase 2 substituted (generic AbortError), summary named the pre-153 gap correctly, console/network clean, both viewport classes inspected. Phase-1 copy corrected to say the abort fires synchronously after fetch() (Copilot review round 1); re-verified.
